test.create_query: CREATE TABLE t_many_parts_wide ( id UInt64, ts DateTime, region LowCardinality(String), mode Enum8('ranked' = 1, 'casual' = 2, 'custom' = 3), kills UInt16, damage UInt32, score Int32, rank Nullable(UInt8), mmr Nullable(Int32), hero LowCardinality(String), items Array(UInt16), bonus UInt32, note String, rounds Nested(idx UInt8, won Bool, dmg UInt32), events Nested(t UInt32, kind LowCardinality(String)), stats Tuple(acc Float32, hs UInt16), tags Map(String, UInt8) ) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0, ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 0.9, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1, parts_to_delay_insert = 100000, parts_to_throw_insert = 100000

CREATE TABLE t_many_parts_compact AS t_many_parts_wide ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id SETTINGS min_bytes_for_wide_part = 1000000000000, ratio_of_defaults_for_sparse_serialization = 0.9, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1, parts_to_delay_insert = 100000, parts_to_throw_insert = 100000
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO t_many_parts_wide SELECT number, toDateTime('2026-01-01 00:00:00') + number, ['eu', 'na', 'asia', 'sa'][number % 4 + 1], toInt8(number % 3 + 1), toUInt16(number % 40), toUInt32(number * 13 % 100000), toInt32(number % 3000) - 1000, if(number % 7 = 0, NULL, toUInt8(number % 20)), if(number % 11 = 0, NULL, toInt32(number % 5000)), ['a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f', 'g', 'h'][number % 8 + 1], arrayMap(i -> toUInt16(i), range(number % 6)), if(number % 50 = 0, toUInt32(number % 1000), 0), if(number % 20 = 0, repeat('x', number % 40), ''), arrayMap(i -> toUInt8(i), range(number % 5)), arrayMap(i -> i % 2 = 0, range(number % 5)), arrayMap(i -> toUInt32(i * 3), range(number % 5)), arrayMap(i -> toUInt32(i * 10), range(number % 3)), arrayMap(i -> ['kill', 'death', 'plant'][i % 3 + 1], range(number % 3)), (toFloat32(number % 100) / 100, toUInt16(number % 20)), map('k', toUInt8(number % 2), 'm', toUInt8(number % 3)) FROM numbers(100000) SETTINGS max_block_size = 10, max_insert_block_size = 10, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, max_insert_threads = 1

INSERT INTO t_many_parts_compact SELECT * FROM t_many_parts_wide SETTINGS max_block_size = 10, max_insert_block_size = 10, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, max_insert_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT sum(length(rounds.idx)), sum(arraySum(rounds.dmg)), countIf(arrayExists(x -> x, rounds.won)) FROM {table} FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(rank.null), sum(items.size0), sum(rounds.idx.size0), sum(stats.hs), sum(length(tags.keys)) FROM {table} FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(damage) FROM {table} PREWHERE length(rounds.idx) > 2 WHERE rounds.dmg[1] > 500 FORMAT Null
